Logo

One mark. Every scale.

The identity is an orbit mark beside a two-tone wordmark: RJM in warm white and Laird in teal, set in Space Grotesk Bold. Every file is outlined, so nothing depends on an installed font.

Primary logo

The horizontal lockup, on Ink.

  • Orbit mark. An outer ring with a planet, an inner ring and a nucleus. It echoes the rotating rings in the site hero.
  • Wordmark. “RJM” in Warm White and “Laird” in Teal, one word with no space. Space Grotesk Bold, +4% tracking.
  • Never retype it. Always place an exported file. Retyping changes weights, tracking and kerning.
Typeface
Space Grotesk Bold (700)
Tracking
+0.04em
Mark colours

Formats

Lockups

Four arrangements, one job each.

  • Horizontal

    The default. Websites, documents, slides, email, headers and footers.

  • Stacked

    Square and portrait spaces: social profiles, posters, report covers, merchandise.

  • Wordmark

    Tight, wide spaces where the orbit mark already appears nearby.

  • Orbit mark

    Favicons, avatars and app icons, and as a graphic device on its own.

Colourways

Match the version to the background.

  • Colour on dark

    The primary version. On Ink, Card, Lift and other dark surfaces.

  • Ink

    One-colour version for Warm White, white and light photography.

  • White

    One-colour version for photography and brand-colour fills that are dark enough.

Never use the colour version on light

Teal on Warm White is only 1.88:1, well below the 3:1 needed for a graphic. On light backgrounds use the Ink version, which is 15.9:1 on Warm White.

Clear space

Keep a margin of X on every side.

X X X X

X is the cap height of the wordmark (the height of the “R”). In the horizontal lockup that is about 37% of the logo’s height.

Nothing enters this zone: no text, edges, images or other logos. Where space is genuinely tight, X may drop to half, but never for print covers or partner lockups.

Minimum sizes

Small, but never fiddly.

Smallest permitted reproduction
LockupDigitalPrintShown at minimum
Horizontal120 px wide30 mm wide
Stacked72 px wide20 mm wide
Wordmark88 px wide22 mm wide
Orbit mark16 px6 mm

The favicon uses a simplified orbit mark with heavier strokes so it survives at 16 px. Don’t scale the full mark below its minimum.

Misuse

Please don’t.
